status: Design frozen before the first new instrumented Catalyst execution; existing orbit tests are calibration, not holdout.
experimental_units: Every changed RuleExecutor logical-plan transition emitted while executing the 18 fixed cases; do not select units based on certificate output.
primary_metric: Among events whose rule name is not in previously investigated rule set, report EQUIVALENT_IN_FRAGMENT, COUNTEREXAMPLE, UNKNOWN, and the exact denominator, per-rule and per-case; also report those counts over all AST events.
eligibility: Only one fixed logical-plan node changes, with identical non-condition metadata and child plan; node Filter(unary) or Join(Inner), both observed through SQL TRUE-row membership. All other transitions classified UNKNOWN. Attributes nullable integral, supported operators EqualTo/EqualNullSafe/And/Or/Not/IsNull/IsNotNull; <=7 identities.
verification: Full TRUE-set equivalence and local replacement partition are exhaustively checked over Bell(n+1) equality/nullness valuation orbits and independently replayed in SQLite; the checker receives no rule names as heuristics.
row_oracle: Compare collected Spark result multisets with independently computed SQLite result multisets on the fixed fixture. A detected mismatch is a finite-fixture discrepancy, and absence of discrepancy is not a universal proof.
prediction: Expect a mixture of supported predicate-only steps and many UNKNOWN structural, literal-bearing, project, join-reordering, or other unsupported transformations; no case is guaranteed to exercise a specific rule.
stop_rules: Do not add/drop/modify cases or grammar after inspecting outcomes for this benchmark.
Do not modify the verifier after inspecting holdout outcomes and score the changed version on the same cases as if untouched.
Treat a local COUNTEREXAMPLE as a distinguishable predicate valuation, not a demonstrated Spark bug without a reachable database witness.
Fail closed for trace parse failures, missing events, all unsupported expression/operator classes.
security: Raw Catalyst toJSON traces can contain SQL literals; keep temporary stderr traces private, delete after sanitization, never attach raw logs. Never run public-fork code on private self-hosted runner absent explicit owner approval.
limitations: SQLite uses integer/NULL 3VL for the narrow supported predicate fragment; runtime differences outside it remain UNKNOWN.
Fixed synthetic finite fixture is not an exhaustive relational oracle.
Rule identities are observations, not pre-selected optimized targets.
Pure expression equivalence doesn't establish arbitrary whole-query semantics when plan structure changes.
required_reporting: event status counts (all and rules uninvestigated)
counts per rule/case and reasons for UNKNOWN
